description_en: Queries the details of a hybrid cloud domain name
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-hybrid-cloud-resource-detail --instance-id waf-cn-0xldbqt0000 --domain www.00000.com --backend 1.1.XX.XX --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --cname-enabled true --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeHybridCloudResourceDetail

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query instance ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable public cloud disaster recovery. Valid values:

true: Public cloud disaster recovery is enabled.

false: Public cloud disaster recovery is disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启公共云容灾。取值：

true：表示开启公共云容灾。

false：表示不开启公共云容灾
parameters.name: cname_enabled

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
